paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s boys beat Florence of Alabama 68–53 in Booneville on Monday, their third straight win since a loss to DeSoto Central. South Pontotoc’s four-game winning streak ended in New Albany, where Alcorn Central broke a fourth-quarter tie to beat the Cougars 48–41.

The Warriors are 4–1. They matched their highest point total of the season against Florence, six days after scoring 68 against Louisville. Between those games they won 59–54 at Tupelo. Florence left the tournament matchup at 3–2.

South Pontotoc took a 20–18 lead into halftime after holding Alcorn Central to four points in the second quarter. The Golden Bears drew even at 36 in the third, then outscored the Cougars 12–5 in the fourth. South Pontotoc stands at 4–3 after opening the season with two losses and winning its next four.
Both county teams are back on the schedule Tuesday. Pontotoc plays Baldwyn at 3 p.m. in Booneville. South Pontotoc meets Mooreville at 5:45 p.m. in New Albany.
